issue_context.title: Caseta Pico remote automations failing since 2022.11
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Since 2022.11, sometimes after a restart all my pico remote automations (triggered when i press a button on a pico) stop working. I can "fix" them temporarily by editing via the UI and saving the changes. I believe a full automation reload would fix it, but i'm not sure calling the automation.reload service actually reloads all the automations any longer since the improvements in 2022.11. I think this may be a race condition wherein the automations get loaded before the caseta devices are ready.

If i open up the automation I can actually see the button presses triggering it via the UI, but the automation doesn't actually fire and there are no traces available.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2022.11

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

core-2022.10

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

lutron_caseta

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/lutron_caseta/

### Diagnostics information

[config_entry-lutron_caseta-75d77f90054a6f4cc16404bc6a8d09f9.json (2).txt](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/files/10058538/config_entry-lutron_caseta-75d77f90054a6f4cc16404bc6a8d09f9.json.2.txt)


### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
alias: Bedroom Fan Remote "On" pressed
description: ""
trigger:
  - platform: device
    device_id: 8f0da392db2b5e244559433b678b5144
    domain: lutron_caseta
    type: press
    subtype: "on"
condition: []
action:
  - type: turn_on
    device_id: c1e197d844278d0a331c8e119257c305
    entity_id: light.bedroom_fan_light
    domain: light
mode: single
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
Got error 'Cannot attach trigger OrderedDict([('platform', 'device'), ('device_id', '8f0da392db2b5e244559433b678b5144'), ('domain', 'lutron_caseta'), ('type', 'press'), ('subtype', 'off')]) because device with id 8f0da392db2b5e244559433b678b5144 is missing or invalid' when setting up triggers for Bedroom Fan Remote "Off" pressed
```


### Additional information

_No response_

If its an setup order issue, might need the new https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/76980 added in 2022.12.x

It is a setup order issue but not one that can be fixed by #76980

The problem is that if the integration isn't up and running by the time the triggers are attached it fails.

For anyone watching this, I have a workaround: watch for events instead of a device trigger. It's even how they do it in the documentation. But its still a bug :)

Also, not integration-related, but it would be nice if automation.reload actually still did what the doc says it does (reload all automations). Or maybe it should accept a boolean for a forced-reload of all automations.

Thanks for the work around! WHere can i find what the event a pico device is firing i dont see ithem in m log book

In developer tools / events, listen for lutron_caseta_button_event events. Then press a button. You'll want the button_number and serial.

My automation trigger looks like this:

```yaml
platform: event
event_type: lutron_caseta_button_event
event_data:
  serial: 47474634
  button_number: 3
  action: press
alias: "\"Favorite\" pressed"

```

I tried to figure out a way to rework this but it since #80797 requires the integration to be setup to attach the trigger its not going to work if the integration isn't setup in time or is in a failed/retry state. 

I think we are going to have to rework that design.  In the mean time I opened #82605 to revert #80797 until we can give that another shot.
